answer_1.quote: We compare an answer with the ground truth and decide its correctness in three ways: computing the keyword overlaps, LLM-as-a-judge with Llama3.3-70B, and decide if the ground truth is entailed in the generated answer.

answer_2.quote: Our overall metric is the E2E QA accuracy for the recall questions, computed as the percentage of questions that are correctly and completely answered.

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM-based (Llama3.3-70B) auto judge to compare the generated answers with the ground truth answers. The entailment score is computed by prompting Flan-T5 with a yes/no question.
